pages.text: Use it on your staff to put them on your $(l)detail$() (six at most). Use it in the air: Follow or Hold. $(k:key.sneak) and use it: they are stood down and go home.
Attack with it in hand: the fighters go for what you point at. Cats, wolves, parrots and foxes are pets: they keep you company instead.$(br2)A detail never follows you through a portal.

Left far behind, or five minutes away from you, they take the company shuttle back to their clock. Nothing is loaded to fetch them.$(br2)A jar needs a Speaker Grille to whistle.$(br2)$(o)An away day is still a working day.$()
